curriculum: The September 2026 full-time Dutch History BA comprises a 120 EC major and 60 EC profiling. Choose the first listed track and package by official order, Foundations of Europe in the History track. The major contains 60 EC of foundation courses, four 7.5 EC package courses, 7.5 EC historical writing, 7.5 EC foundations and 15 EC bachelor thesis. The 60 EC profiling includes a 30 EC minor or approved study abroad package and 30 EC free choices, with a maximum 15 EC internship. At least 15 EC of profiling is at level 2 or 3. External minors and study abroad require advance approval. The second track and other packages are valid academic directions, not components of the selected example.
progression: Year 1 pairs a period course and methods or discipline course in each block. Its six level-1 courses supply the required 45 EC before the Foundations of Europe courses, writing and context. In Year 2 the package is taken one course per block in the order power and religion, cities, Seminar A and Seminar B. Historical Writing is in block 1 and Foundations of History in block 2. Before the two-block thesis, students earn 30 EC at level 3 and complete a qualifying Seminar A, met by the four package courses. The 30 EC advanced package plus 7.5 EC foundations and 15 EC thesis meets the major minimum of 45 EC advanced study. Profiling contributes 15 EC in Year 2 and 45 EC in Year 3 in the standard pattern.

The writing course and Foundations of History also require 45 EC at introductory level.
Students must earn at least 30 EC at advanced level and complete a qualifying Research Seminar A before starting the 15 EC thesis.
Choose a minor or approved study abroad. Across the full 60 EC of electives, at least 15 EC must be at level 2 or 3.
Options include individual courses, a second minor or an internship of up to 15 EC.
